name: field-fieldsets
title: Fieldsets of choices
description: Fieldsets of choices. Core/Field pattern composed from @gaudi/design-system/core/Field and other public Gaudi components; the components stay package imports.
docs: Copy-in pattern built on @gaudi/design-system; the components stay package imports. Load '@gaudi/design-system/global.css' once and add transpilePackages: ['@gaudi/design-system'] in Next.js. Until the package is on npm, install it from GitHub first: pnpm add github:ahmadassaf/design-system.

files.content:
import { CheckboxRoot as Checkbox } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Checkbox'; import { FieldRoot as Field, FieldContent, FieldDescriptionPrimitive as FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLabelPrimitive as FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSeparator, FieldSet, FieldTitle } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Field'; import { RadioGroupRoot as RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/RadioGroup'; import { SwitchRoot as Switch } from '@gaudi/design-system/core/Switch'; const channels = [ { id: 'push', title: 'Push notifications', description: 'Alerts sent to your device in real time.', checked: true }, { id: 'digest', title: 'Email digest', description: 'A daily summary sent to your inbox.', checked: true }, { id: 'sms', title: 'SMS alerts', description: 'Text messages for critical notifications only.', checked: false } ]; const permissions = [ { id: 'read', title: 'Read', description: 'View resources and data.', checked: true }, { id: 'write', title: 'Write', description: 'Create and edit resources.', checked: true }, { id: 'delete', title: 'Delete', description: 'Permanently remove resources.', checked: false }, { id: 'admin', title: 'Admin', description: 'Only available to workspace owners.', checked: false, disabled: true } ]; export function Pattern() { return (
Notification channels {channels.map((item) => ( {item.title} {item.description} ))}
Access permissions Configure what this role can access. {permissions.map((item) => ( {item.title} {item.description} ))}
Profile privacy Public, visible to everyone Private, only visible to you
); }
